name: Fígols (Spain)
description: Divided into two equal vertical parts, black at the hoist and white at the fly, charged at the centre with the sexfoil of the arms counterchanged, white on the black and black on the white.
history: The flag was approved on 10 November 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4767 of 23 November 2006; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided into two equal vertical parts, black at the hoist and white at the fly, with the sexfoil of the arms at the centre, white where it rests on the black and black where it rests on the white.

features.role: sexfoil counterchanged, white on black and black on white
